about_the_game:
Hack 'N' Slash Action RPG in a Steampunk World

Take on the role of a convict who has been thrown into the dungeons by a powerful ruling organization. Embark on a journey through a world devastated by a mysterious asteroid, scattering powerful crystal shards across distinct world zones brimming with mutated creatures and steampunk enemies.

Delve into post-apocalyptic dungeons that randomize upon each visit and ascend to new heights of power with epic loot, extensive talent tree progression, theorycrafting and lootable skills.

ANIMAL HYBRID HEROES

Choose between powerful hybrid animal characters with unique skills and talent trees.

EXTENSIVE TALENT TREE PROGRESSION

Embark on your path to mastery with an expanding tree of talents. Gain experience and unlock new powers to form synergies with your items and skills.

LOOTABLE SKILLS WITH RANDOMIZED SKILL TREES

Uncover a treasure trove of skills in different rarities. Unlock your path of choice through procedurally generated skill trees and master your style of play.

DEEP ITEMIZATION

Loot, craft and modify your items. Meet other players, create guilds, and trade items with your friends.

SEASONS

Seasons offer new thrilling adventures and challenges, as the catastrophic Nexus strikes the world, wiping out the memories and possessions of all characters.

MULTIPLAYER

Play singleplayer or multiplayer as you delve into dungeons in search of challenges and rewards.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
